name: Outline
description: The fastest wiki and knowledge base for growing teams, self-hosted

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database (all documents, collections and users), uploaded files in storage/, Redis data, secret keys and settings.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Outline web app, API and mail viewer (/mail), published on host as 6155

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: The exact address you open Outline at, like http://192.168.1.20:6155. Change localhost to your server IP. Outline only works at this address, so use your own domain (https://...) if you put it behind a reverse proxy.
